data.summary: The pod startup was delayed primarily by an exceptionally slow image pull, which took 56.5 seconds to download 53 MB. The throughput was only 0.9 MB/s, significantly below the expected performance threshold. Application initialisation itself was efficient and completed in under one second.

findings.statement: The image pull phase lasted 56.488 seconds for a 53,328,919 byte image.
The image pull throughput was 944,075 bytes per second (approximately 0.9 MB/s), which is below the 5 MB/s threshold.
Application initialisation was fast, taking only 0.909 seconds.

ruled_out.reason: The image size is only 53 MB, which is relatively small; the delay is caused by low throughput rather than image size.
Application initialisation took only 0.909 seconds, which is well within acceptable limits.
Scheduling duration was 0.0 seconds, indicating no delay in pod placement.

recommendations.rationale: The throughput of 0.9 MB/s is significantly lower than expected, suggesting network congestion or registry latency issues.
